title: AIP Morning Brief — Trailer: meet Maya and Jordan!
show_notes: **Trailer.** What The AIP Morning Brief covers: client capex signals, competitors, macro and SaaS benchmarks, scored by confidence with base, best and worst cases — and three things to raise with the CFO every morning. Hosted by Maya and Jordan.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Morning, and welcome to The AIP Morning Brief. I'm Maya.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: And I'm Jordan. Grab a coffee, there's a lot going on in infrastructure right now.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: There usually is. So, here's how it works. Every morning, in about ten minutes, we cover the news that moves asset investment planning. Utility rate cases, regulators, grid and water spending, competitors...

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: ...and the money side. Interest rates, SaaS valuations, the numbers that actually matter.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: And Jordan doesn't just read the headlines.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: No, I'll tell you what I think. Every story gets a confidence rating, and for the big ones you'll get the best case, the worst case, and where I think it really lands.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Opinionated, but only when the evidence earns it.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: Exactly. And we finish every episode with three things worth raising with your CFO that day.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Short, sharp, and hopefully useful. See you tomorrow at six.
